about.short: ML / AI Engineer working across machine learning, NLP, LLMs, Knowledge Graphs, data science, algorithms and performance-oriented computer systems.
about.long: I am an ML / AI Engineer with a strong foundation in machine learning, algorithms, software engineering and data-driven problem solving. My work spans machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, large language models, Knowledge Graphs, data analytics and performance-oriented software engineering. At the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), I worked as a Student Researcher in the Statistics and Machine Learning Lab on LLM-based question answering, Knowledge Graphs and hallucinations in large language models, including collaborative research with British Telecom. I have also worked on diverse data analytics and deep learning projects involving NLP, recommendation systems, machine translation, time-series sensor data and statistical analysis. At IBM, I work on performance-critical routing and chip-design software, applying algorithms, computational geometry and optimization to large-scale engineering problems. This combination of AI/ML research and systems engineering allows me to approach problems from both a data-driven and algorithmic perspective.

education.description: Graduate study at IISc with research exposure in machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, large language models and Knowledge Graph-based systems. Worked in the Statistics and Machine Learning Lab and collaborated with British Telecom on improving question answering using Knowledge Graphs.

Undergraduate study covering computer science fundamentals, algorithms, machine learning and software development. Completed a B.Tech. thesis on a movie recommendation system using content-based and collaborative filtering.

experience.description: Work on complex routing and chip-design problems as part of the Routing Development team. Apply algorithms, data structures, computational geometry and optimization to develop high-performance solutions for large-scale routing problems.

Conducted machine learning and NLP research involving large language models and Knowledge Graphs. Collaborated with British Telecom on improving LLM-based question answering and explored approaches for improving factual accuracy and reasoning.
Worked on routing quality and chip-design software using C++ and computational geometry.

Worked in the Sensor and GPS R&D team. Independently collected and processed time-series sensor data and developed a machine learning model to infer smartphone usage states for power-efficiency improvements.

projects.name: Data Analytics Projects
projects.description: Completed multiple end-to-end data analytics and machine learning projects across sports, healthcare, neuroscience, space science, social networks and recommendation systems. The projects involved statistical modelling, numerical optimization, graph algorithms, hypothesis testing, time-series and scientific data analysis, and machine learning on real-world datasets. Topics included Duckworth–Lewis–Stern cricket resource modelling, COVID-19 modelling, colour blindness analysis, visual processing, Mars orbit reconstruction, community detection, hypothesis testing and recommendation systems.

projects.name: Deep Learning with Natural Language Processing
projects.description: Worked on deep learning and natural language processing projects including sentiment analysis using LSTM networks on large-scale textual review datasets and neural machine translation for converting dates written in different formats into a standardized representation. The translation system used an encoder-decoder architecture with attention to learn mappings between variable textual date formats.

projects.name: Forecasting with Temporal Knowledge Graphs
projects.description: Research project exploring temporal Knowledge Graphs in which event timestamps are associated with entity relationships, enabling reasoning and forecasting over time.

projects.name: Knowledge Graph Reasoning and Knowledge Graph-Based Question Answering
projects.description: Conducted collaborative research on improving question answering with large language models through Knowledge Graph integration and advanced retrieval strategies. Explored and benchmarked LLM architectures and QA datasets using structured knowledge grounding and hybrid symbolic-neural approaches.

projects.name: Optimization in Chip Design with Routing Quality Checker
projects.description: Designed and developed a Routing Quality Checker to detect routing quality degradation and violations in chip layouts and recommend timing- and noise-aware fix-up strategies. Worked with large-scale multi-layer 3D geometries and computationally hard optimization problems.

projects.name: Short Fixing in Chip Design
projects.description: Designed and implemented a high-performance 3D sweep-line algorithm for detecting short-circuit violations across large-scale chip layouts. Developed a timing-aware rerouting framework to resolve wire shorts without introducing secondary violations.

projects.name: Free-Hand Routing
projects.description: Developed a free-hand routing approach that allows designers to sketch routing topologies naturally while the system translates the sketches into DRC-clean, manufacturable layouts. A patent was filed for the core methodology and implementation.

projects.name: Optimizing Power Consumption on Smartphones using Machine Learning
projects.description: Collected and processed time-series sensor data from smartphones and developed a Naive Bayes-based usage-state classifier to infer active and inactive device states for adaptive power-efficiency improvements.

projects.name: Movie Recommendation System
projects.description: Built an end-to-end movie recommendation system combining content-based and collaborative filtering techniques on MovieLens data. Addressed data sparsity, cold-start and search ambiguity and deployed an interactive web interface using Django.

research.title: Hallucinations in Large Language Models
research.description: M.Tech thesis at IISc investigating hallucination phenomena in large language models. Conducted controlled experiments using prompting strategies and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques with the MedHALT dataset to analyze factual inconsistency and evaluate mitigation approaches.

research.title: Enhancing Question Answering with Large Language Models
research.description: Collaborative research with IISc and British Telecom on improving question answering performance in large language models through Knowledge Graph integration and advanced retrieval strategies. Explored structured knowledge grounding and hybrid symbolic-neural approaches.
research.organization: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) / British Telecom

research.title: Free-Hand Routing using AI
research.description: Patent work at IBM India involving an AI-based approach for interpreting hand-drawn routing layouts and translating them into structured, DRC-clean routing topologies, reducing manual effort in complex chip-design workflows.
